symbols.name: selected chunk count
symbols.meaning: The number of address chunks carrying a selected bit.
symbols.quote: The simultaneous butterfly layer applies $H_0$ coefficientwise to one bit of each of $D\le d$ address chunks of $K$ bits at once, in time $O(Vd^{\lambda'})$ for fixed $\lambda'<1$ rather than $D$ whole-array passes.

symbols.name: record array
symbols.meaning: The array of records, a function of the address x.
symbols.quote: Let $z$ be the array of records at addresses $x$, with selected bits $x_1,\dots,x_D$.

symbols.name: address
symbols.meaning: An address of the array, with selected bits x_1,...,x_D.
symbols.quote: Let $z$ be the array of records at addresses $x$, with selected bits $x_1,\dots,x_D$.

symbols.name: phase diagonal
symbols.meaning: The diagonal operator multiplying the record at address x by i^{x_1+...+x_D}.
symbols.quote: Then $H_0^{\otimes D}=b^D\mathcal S_DC^{\otimes D}\mathcal S_D$ with $(\mathcal S_Dz)(x)=i^{x_1+\dots+x_D}z(x)$, an exact Gaussian dyadic operation: $b^D=(-i/2)^{\lfloor D/2\rfloor}b^{D\bmod2}$ is a shift, a phase and at most one factor $b$.

symbols.name: group axis count
symbols.meaning: The number of axes in a group, e = mf.
symbols.quote: A group of $e=mf$ axes ($e$ counts them) forms $m$ slots of $f$ axes; a column is the vector in $\mathbb F_2^m$ of the same bit of each slot.

symbols.name: slot index
symbols.meaning: Index of a slot, and of the residual basis vector placed on it.
symbols.quote: Each edge changes frame by $\prod_hC_{v_h}^{\eta_h}$ on every column, over a basis $v_h$ of its residual space, $\eta_h=\pm1$, $C_v=aI+bX_v$, $X_v$ shifting a column by $v$.

symbols.name: residual vector
symbols.meaning: A vector of a basis of the edge's residual space, in F_2^m.
symbols.quote: Each edge changes frame by $\prod_hC_{v_h}^{\eta_h}$ on every column, over a basis $v_h$ of its residual space, $\eta_h=\pm1$, $C_v=aI+bX_v$, $X_v$ shifting a column by $v$.

symbols.name: edge sign
symbols.meaning: The sign +1 or -1 of the kernel exponent attached to residual vector v_h.
symbols.quote: Each edge changes frame by $\prod_hC_{v_h}^{\eta_h}$ on every column, over a basis $v_h$ of its residual space, $\eta_h=\pm1$, $C_v=aI+bX_v$, $X_v$ shifting a column by $v$.

symbols.name: shifted kernel
symbols.meaning: The matrix aI+bX_v, the kernel C applied along the column direction v.
symbols.quote: Each edge changes frame by $\prod_hC_{v_h}^{\eta_h}$ on every column, over a basis $v_h$ of its residual space, $\eta_h=\pm1$, $C_v=aI+bX_v$, $X_v$ shifting a column by $v$.

symbols.name: column shift
symbols.meaning: The operator shifting the address of a column by v.
symbols.quote: Each edge changes frame by $\prod_hC_{v_h}^{\eta_h}$ on every column, over a basis $v_h$ of its residual space, $\eta_h=\pm1$, $C_v=aI+bX_v$, $X_v$ shifting a column by $v$.

symbols.name: basis matrix
symbols.meaning: An invertible binary m by m matrix whose first columns are the residual vectors v_h.
symbols.quote: For invertible $G$ with first columns $v_h$ and $\mathcal P_G:x\mapsto Gx$, $\mathcal P_GX_v\mathcal P_G^{-1}=X_{Gv}$

symbols.name: basis permutation
symbols.meaning: The address permutation moving a column value x to Gx.
symbols.quote: For invertible $G$ with first columns $v_h$ and $\mathcal P_G:x\mapsto Gx$, $\mathcal P_GX_v\mathcal P_G^{-1}=X_{Gv}$

symbols.name: standard basis vector
symbols.meaning: The h-th standard basis vector of F_2^m.
symbols.quote: so the edge change is $\mathcal P_G\bigl(\prod_hC_{e_h}^{\eta_h}\bigr)\mathcal P_G^{-1}$, $e_h$ standard basis vectors.

symbols.name: sign matrix
symbols.meaning: The diagonal matrix diag(1,-1).
symbols.quote: As $(C^{-1})^{\otimes f}=(-i)^fZ^{\otimes f}C^{\otimes f}Z^{\otimes f}$, $Z=\operatorname{diag}(1,-1)$, inverse children need only signs and phases.

symbols.name: row quotient
symbols.meaning: The quotient of a row index on division by W.
symbols.quote: Row $Wg+w$ (quotient $g$, remainder $0\le w<W$) goes to wire role $w$, so children have volume $V/W$.

symbols.name: row remainder
symbols.meaning: The remainder of a row index modulo W, which is the wire role.
symbols.quote: Row $Wg+w$ (quotient $g$, remainder $0\le w<W$) goes to wire role $w$, so children have volume $V/W$.

symbols.name: row chunk count
symbols.meaning: The number of leading chunks whose bits form the row index.
symbols.quote: The rows are the bits of the first $q_0=\lceil\log_2W\rceil\lceil\log_m(2d)\rceil$ chunks, $q_0$ counting chunks, handled individually in $O(V\log d)$, all chunks if $D\le q_0$.

symbols.name: step ratio
symbols.meaning: The ratio s/W, at most m^sigma.
symbols.quote: Take $\sigma<1$ with $\gamma=s/W\le m^\sigma$, $K\le d^c$ for fixed $c>0$, and $\lambda$ with $\max\{\tau,\sigma\}<\lambda<1$, $\tau(1+c/\beta)<\lambda$.

symbols.name: level count
symbols.meaning: The number of recursion levels descended.
symbols.quote: After $j$ levels a leaf has $u=e/m^j<d^\beta$ chunks and $\gamma^j\le(e/u)^\sigma$, so leaves add $O(\gamma^ju)\le O(e^\sigma d^{\beta(1-\sigma)})$.

symbols.name: leaf chunks
symbols.meaning: The number of active chunks in a leaf after j levels, e/m^j.
symbols.quote: After $j$ levels a leaf has $u=e/m^j<d^\beta$ chunks and $\gamma^j\le(e/u)^\sigma$, so leaves add $O(\gamma^ju)\le O(e^\sigma d^{\beta(1-\sigma)})$.

symbols.name: piece digit
symbols.meaning: The base-m digit of D-q_0 at position j, the number of pieces of m^j chunks.
symbols.quote: Writing $D-q_0=\sum_ja_jm^j$, $0\le a_j<m$, gives $a_j$ pieces of $m^j$ chunks, at most $(m-1)(1+\lfloor\log_md\rfloor)$, hence a $\log(2d)$ factor:

symbols.name: chain bound
symbols.meaning: A(e) bounds the number of arithmetic operations on a chain from an input coefficient to an intermediate one in a group of e axes.
symbols.quote: Let $A(e)$ bound the operations on a chain from an input coefficient to an intermediate one.

symbols.name: invocation bound
symbols.meaning: The bound 64(W+m+1)^3 on operations added on a chain by one network invocation.
symbols.quote: An invocation adds fewer than $E=64(W+m+1)^3$ (gates $24W^3$, corrections $4s+4W+4$, $s<Wm$), and chains concatenate the $s$ children: $A(e)\le sA(e/m)+E$, $A(e)\le8e$ at leaves.

symbols.name: bound
symbols.meaning: Any bound of at least 1 on the chain length.
symbols.quote: For any bound $\xi\ge1$, $s\xi+E\le B\xi$, $B=s+E$;

symbols.name: recurrence base
symbols.meaning: The sum s+E.
symbols.quote: For any bound $\xi\ge1$, $s\xi+E\le B\xi$, $B=s+E$;

symbols.name: depth exponent
symbols.meaning: The least j at least 1 with m^j at least B.
symbols.quote: with $\nu=\min\{j\ge1:m^j\ge B\}$ and at most $\lceil\log_md\rceil$ levels, $A(e)\le8B^2d^{\nu+1}$.

symbols.name: guard constant
symbols.meaning: The constant 128mB^2 in the guard width.
symbols.quote: Adding pieces, diagonals and $b^D$ stays below $\Delta=\lceil C_0d^{C_1}\rceil$, $C_0=128mB^2$, $C_1=\max\{20,\nu+3\}=20$ here.

symbols.name: chain depth
symbols.meaning: The number of operations along a chain, the depth of a value.
symbols.quote: By induction on chain depth $\ell$, values lie in $2^{-(p+\ell)}\mathbb Z[i]$ with modulus at most $2^\ell$: addition doubles modulus, halving adds a denominator bit.

symbols.name: axis exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent with d = Theta(p^epsilon).
symbols.quote: For $d=\Theta(p^\epsilon)$ with fixed exponent $\epsilon$ and $\epsilon C_1<1$, $\Delta=o(p)$: width $O(p)$.

relations.quote: The network of [Binary phase frames](phase-frames.md) computes $C^{\otimes e}$.
Gaussian elimination writes $G$ as at most $m(m-1)+3m$ row additions, each XORing selected bits of two slots, performed by [Packed selected-bit addition](packed-bit-addition.md).
The layer gets its power saving from [Recursive power saving](rank-recurrence.md), whose recurrence this is.
The layer is evaluated exactly in [fixed-point Gaussian dyadic records](fixed-point.md).

derivations.quote: The [two-point kernel $C$](phase-kernel.md), $C=aI+bX$, with $\mathsf S=\operatorname{diag}(1,i)$ satisfies $H_0=b\,\mathsf SC\mathsf S$, $C^2=X$, $C^4=I$

Gaussian elimination writes $G$ as at most $m(m-1)+3m$ row additions, each XORing selected bits of two slots, performed by [Packed selected-bit addition](packed-bit-addition.md). Apply $\mathcal P_G^{-1}$ per column, then $(C^{\eta_h})^{\otimes f}$ to the $f$ bits of slot $h$, then $\mathcal P_G$: one child on $f=e/m$ axes per residual vector, exactly $s$ in all. As $(C^{-1})^{\otimes f}=(-i)^fZ^{\otimes f}C^{\otimes f}Z^{\otimes f}$, $Z=\operatorname{diag}(1,-1)$, inverse children need only signs and phases.

Then $H_0^{\otimes D}=b^D\mathcal S_DC^{\otimes D}\mathcal S_D$ with $(\mathcal S_Dz)(x)=i^{x_1+\dots+x_D}z(x)$, an exact Gaussian dyadic operation: $b^D=(-i/2)^{\lfloor D/2\rfloor}b^{D\bmod2}$ is a shift, a phase and at most one factor $b$.
So the complete basis change and its inverse on $e$ axis chunks cost $O(V((eK)^\tau+1))$

As $K\le e^{c/\beta}$ for $e\ge d^\beta$, overhead is $O(e^\lambda)$ and internal levels sum to $O(e^\lambda)\sum_{j\ge0}(\gamma/m^\lambda)^j=O(e^\lambda)$. After $j$ levels a leaf has $u=e/m^j<d^\beta$ chunks and $\gamma^j\le(e/u)^\sigma$, so leaves add $O(\gamma^ju)\le O(e^\sigma d^{\beta(1-\sigma)})$.

By induction on chain depth $\ell$, values lie in $2^{-(p+\ell)}\mathbb Z[i]$ with modulus at most $2^\ell$: addition doubles modulus, halving adds a denominator bit. So $p+\Delta$ fractional and $\Delta+3$ integer and sign bits per real component represent every intermediate coefficient exactly
Each row of $H_0$ has absolute row sum one, and absolute row sums multiply under tensor products, so every row of $\mathcal H=H_0^{\otimes D}$ has absolute row sum one

Truncation toward zero cannot increase either component's absolute value, so $Q_p$ keeps the disk and changes each component by less than $2^{-p}$: $\|Q_p(\mathcal Hz)-\mathcal Hz\|_\infty<\sqrt2\,2^{-p}$
